Co10Ce10@MCM-48: (111) of CeO2 with an interplanar spacing of 0.31 nm
(311) and (111) of Co3O4 with spacings of 0.243 nm and 0.469 nm respectively

Proof in the paper: In Fig. 1 (b1-b3), HRTEM image of Co10Ce10@MCM-48 exhibited the existence of (111) lattice fringes of CeO2 with the interplanar spacing of 0.31 nm. The lattice fringes of Co with a spacing of 0.243 and 0.469 nm were respectively Co3O4 (311) and (111) planes.
